gloss: to tilt; to incline; to cock (one's head)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {傾|かし}げていませんでした

definitions.explanation: to lean or slant something to one side

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{首|くび}を{傾|かし}げた→首を傾げる：17531_kubiwokashigeru⟧。
examples.english: She tilted her head, looking puzzled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{首|くび}を{傾|かし}げて→首を傾げる：17531_kubiwokashigeru⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The dog is looking with its head tilted.

notes:
{傾|かし}げる most commonly appears in the expression ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾|かし}げる (tilt one's head).

VERB TYPE:
- Ichidan verb (る-verb)
- Transitive

WRITING:
- Uses {傾|かし}げる from ⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧ (to lean)
- Alternative reading: {傾|かた}げる (same meaning, less common)

KEY EXPRESSION:
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾|かし}げる is by far the most common usage
- Indicates puzzlement, confusion, or curiosity
- Can describe humans or animals

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾|かし}げる (tilt one's head - questioning gesture)
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾|かし}げる (tilt head as if puzzled)
- ⟦{疑問|ぎもん}→疑問：02648_gimon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じて→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾|かし}げる (tilt head in doubt)

USAGE:
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{傾|かし}げる typically implies doubt or confusion
- Shows the person doesn't understand or questions something
- Very visual, often used in descriptions

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧ (to tilt, lean - more general)
- ⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧ (to lean, incline - intransitive)

DIFFERENCE FROM {傾|かたむ}ける:
- {傾|かし}げる: Usually for ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ (head), expressive gesture
- ⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧: More general tilting of objects

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in both speech and writing.
